entities.summary: Ekaterina "Kate" Mikhailovna Antropova is an Iceland-born Italian professional volleyball player. In 2022 she was named CEV Women's Challenge Cup-Most valuable player, in 2023 was named CEV Cup-Most valuable player, and in 2025 was named FIVB Volleyball Women's Club World Championship Most valuable player and best Opposite Hitter.
